PRO.definition_en: Proteins, protein families/complexes, domains and named mutants; includes transcription factors, receptors, enzymes, antibodies, and viral proteins.

DNA.definition_en: Genomic sequences, genes, promoters/enhancers, motifs, loci and DNA-level variants or edits.

CTY.definition_en: Cell types defined by lineage, function, or morphology, including immune subsets and disease-state qualified types.

RNA.definition_en: RNA mentions including mRNA/tRNA/rRNA, specific transcripts, and cDNA libraries; exons/introns when discussed at transcript level.

final_task_goal: This corpus standardizes biomedical entity spans in molecular-biology abstracts to support curation-ready structuring of the literature. * Document pool and source: MEDLINE abstracts retrieved with queries on ‘human’, ‘blood cells’, and ‘transcription factors’. * Purpose of NER: Consistently tag contiguous spans for proteins, DNA elements, RNA/transcripts, cell types, and cell lines with strict boundary conventions that reflect experimental reporting. * Entity types: Five—PRO (protein), DNA, RNA, CTY (cell type), CLN (cell line). * Downstream applications: Enable biocuration pipelines, populate pathway/interaction databases, accelerate literature triage for molecule/cell/context indexing, and aggregate cross-paper evidence about targets and regulatory elements.
